# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011)</sub>; Master Robin  <sub>[v2 c17 P35](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0035)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is an attractive young boy with a round skull covered by fuzzy, tiny yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose, a single dimple in one cheek that indents when he laughs, and eyes that dance with elfish roguishness. Unlike his twin sister Lucy, he is broader in build.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)_

## Personality

Robin is naturally playful, inquisitive, and mischievous, constantly asking questions about how things work or where things go. Though prone to forgetfulness, carelessness, and troublesome pranks, he possesses an affectionate and warm nature that easily wins over others. He expresses his emotions candidly, hates dull routine, and prefers active, thrilling fun over sitting motionless.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c10 P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c17 P14](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0014), [v2 c18 P12](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0012), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032)_

## History

Following the death of his mother, Mary Farrow, Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by Thirza Abernethy to live at Grey Shutters. Upon arriving, he immediately caused endless anxiety for Thirza and Nell Harcourt through his unruly behavior, continuous pranks, and uninhibited antics—such as dropping a furry caterpillar down Lauretta White's dress during church and putting a toad in Thirza's bed. After locking Lucy in a barn and lying about her disappearance, he burst into remorse when he realized he had made Nell cry, swearing never to speak another untruth. Over time, under Nell's patient guidance and gentle instruction, his behavior gradually improved. When his uncle Richard Farrow passed away, he left a trust fund ensuring Robin and Lucy could permanently remain at Grey Shutters. Robin began attending school alongside Lucy, making friends with his classmate Milty Gammon, and eventually warmed up to Cedric Stanhope.
